title: Preparation of RNAse Free 4% Paraformaldehyde in 0.1M PB
author: Monique Copeland
materials: Top off to 500ml with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Prepare Basic Water Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a basic water solution to facilitate the dissolution of paraformaldehyde.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 mL of Nuclease-free water to a 1000 mL beaker.
Add a stir bar to the beaker and place it on a hot plate set to 50 °C.
Add 5 drops (500 µL) of 10N NaOH (Thomas Scientific Catalog #C871W32).

steps.title: Dissolve Paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Dissolve the paraformaldehyde in the prepared solution.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 20 g of Paraformaldehyde (Catalog #19200) and add it to the water.
Stir for approximately 1 hour (01:00:00) or until the solution is clear and all paraformaldehyde is dissolved.

steps.title: Prepare 1M Phosphate Buffer (PB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of 1M Phosphate buffer at pH 7.4.

substeps.instruction: Combine 19 mL of 1M Sodium phosphate Monobasic and 81 mL of 1M Sodium Dibasic dihydrate (Fisher Scientific Catalog #S472-500).

steps.title: Combine and Adjust pH
steps.instruction: Combine the buffer with the paraformaldehyde solution and finalize the pH.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL of the prepared 1M PB (pH 7.4) to the paraformaldehyde solution.
Test the pH and adjust the solution to a final pH of 7.4 using HCl or NaOH.

steps.title: Filter and Store Solution
steps.instruction: Filter the final solution and store it under appropriate conditions.

substeps.instruction: Filter the solution through a 0.2 µm CA membrane filter (Corning™ Disposable Vacuum Filter/Storage Systems, Fisher Scientific Catalog #09-761-5).
Label the container as 'RNAse free 4% paraformaldehyed in .1M PB' with the date.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 week, or aliquot into 50 mL Falcon Tubes (Fisher Scientific) and store at -20 °C for 3 months.
